versions.changelog:
1-Click WOA 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Enable one-click publication of WeChat Official Account drafts from Markdown input, automating token retrieval, image upload, draft creation, and publishing.
- Seamlessly handles Chinese text encoding and switches to an HTML fallback if publishing fails.
- Supports multiple activation phrases and WeChat Draft API integration.
- Provides clear instructions on credential setup, image requirements, and known limitations.
